spans.s: AF1048 क्रुद्धशूरं अक्रुद्धभीरु kruddhaśūraṁ akruddhabhīru Violent when angry and fearful when anger subsides, an indication of mental constitution.

SK0108 क्रूर कोष्ठ krūra koṣṭha A physiological type of Koṣṭha produced because of the dominance of Vāta. The individual with this type of Koṣṭha, passes hard stools and has irregular digestive ability.
